canonical_vocabulary.describes: FROZEN backbone. Fact asserts content about a subject.
canonical_vocabulary.evaluated: FROZEN backbone. Proposition evaluated against evidence/subject.
canonical_vocabulary.instantiates: FROZEN backbone. Instance member of a concept/type.
canonical_vocabulary.identified_by: FROZEN backbone. Entity anchored to canonical identity.
canonical_vocabulary.governed_by: FROZEN backbone. Subject under an authority binding.
canonical_vocabulary.evidences: FROZEN backbone. Node provides evidence for a claim.
canonical_vocabulary.references: Governed general: cross-entity pointer with no stronger claim. Default for field-refs unless evidence supports a stronger term. Store-agnostic; never implies hierarchy, membership, or generation.
canonical_vocabulary.contains: Governed general: collection membership (source holds target as member). For schema listings, item lists, comment/post/event/session collections.
canonical_vocabulary.defines: Governed general: source specifies the schema/contract of target. For inputSchema and specification references only.
canonical_vocabulary.produces: Governed general: source generatively yields target (execution/evaluation producing results). Used only with subject/object evidence; otherwise references.

evidence_notes.parent: references by default; specializes only with hierarchy evidence (forum/nav parent ambiguous).
evidence_notes.parentService: references by default; hierarchy claim requires evidence.
evidence_notes.activation: references; initiates reserved pending lifecycle-evidence review.
evidence_notes.rollback: references; reverts reserved pending lifecycle-evidence review.
evidence_notes.execution: references; produces reserved pending subject/object generative evidence.
evidence_notes.evaluation: references; produces reserved pending subject/object generative evidence.
evidence_notes.cer: references; CCNF envelope pointer, not hierarchy.
evidence_notes.lease: references; lease pointer per execution vocabulary.

rule: Original field name preserved in properties.relation_payload on every remapped edge. No information loss; vocabulary bounded to 10 terms (6 frozen + 4 governed).

exceptions.policy: Permanent documented exceptions per ratified ruling c0345945 (architect, ratifying ontologist 1a1084d0): collision groups where remapping onto the canonical term would force uq_graph_edges to merge semantically distinct governed edges. The non-representative member(s) of each group retain their original field-name relation_type, carry properties.relation_payload AND properties.exception, and are NOT remapped. This section is part of the pinned Decision B artifact; the PC6 contract fingerprint includes this file's sha256.
exceptions.note: source/target are concept-name tails of graph_edges.source_id/target_id (store prefix e.g. resolution:concept: stripped); source_section/target_section are the graph_edges section columns.

groups.rationale: Four role-distinct governance relationships (who evaluates, what contract, which law, what bridge); merging collapses the authority-binding distinctions the model exists to preserve.
Subject (the lineage's event) vs members (its children); merging confuses a lineage with its own subject.
A-side vs B-side of a join; an undifferentiated join edge is worse than no edge because it asserts a relationship whose semantics it erased.
Author vs recipient — opposite directions; directionality (who wrote it vs who received it) must remain queryable.

analyst_constraints_honored: no parallel hierarchy (specializes unused pending evidence)
extends reconciles to Resolution vocabulary, not a Shrapnel-local term
